units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:17">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>, end.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44a:5">Ab. Zar. 44ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="M02219"><he>מפלצת</he></cite>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 15:16">II Chr. XV, 16</cite>) <he>כמין ז׳</he> a phallus.
<cite ref="Menachot 6a:12">Men. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>תמות וז׳ בבהמה</he> unblemished condition and male sex of sacrifices are required only of cattle.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:6:4">Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9ᵈ</cite> <he>צד ז׳</he> the male side of the hermaphrodite; <he>מכח זַכְרוּתוֹ</he> in as much as he is a male; a. fr.

senses.gloss: the thin and pointed side of a double tool.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 31b:3">Bets. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ שלו</he> the sharper side of a hatchet (used for splitting), opp. <he>נקבות שלו</he> the broader side.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> [read:] <he>כאדם שמטביל זַכְרוּתוֹ של מכחול בים</he> as much as one takes up when dipping the point of the painting staff into the paint bottle.

senses.gloss: the fructifying principle, germ, bud, eye or strophiole (in plants); germinating spot (in eggs) &c., v. next w.—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:19">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᵈ</cite> bot.; XII, 13ᶜ bot. <he>כדי ליטע זַכְרוּתָהּ של חיטה</he> deep enough to plant the wheat grain up to its eye (so that it can take root).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:6:11">Y. Ter. X, end, 47ᶜ</cite> <he>ז׳ של חלמון</he> that part of the yolk where germination sets in; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:6:11">ib.</cite> <he>ז׳ של מוח</he> the germinating point in the white of the egg (the more substantial and cohesive part).

senses.gloss: the bony inside of an animal’s horn or hoofs, the bony projection over which the horny substance grows.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:7:4">Y. Erub. I, 19ᵇ</cite> bot.
